description: Update an existing bot's configuration. Only provided fields are modified; omitted fields remain unchanged.

assignment.description: One-sentence role definition for the bot (max 2000 chars)

escalationPrompt.description: Prompt template used when escalating to a human agent (max 5000 chars)

fallbackMessage.description: Message sent when the bot cannot understand user input (max 2000 chars)

greetingMessage.description: Automatic greeting sent when a new conversation starts (max 2000 chars)

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the bot to update

llmTemperature.description: Temperature parameter controlling response randomness (0 = deterministic, 2 = creative)

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens the bot can generate per response

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata object stored with the bot. Replaces the entire metadata field — include ALL existing keys you want to keep. Known keys: 'communityExitFollowUp' (auto-DM users who leave watched groups — { enabled: boolean, groupJids: string[], message: string with {name} placeholder }), 'learningConfig' (self-learning from conversations — { enabled: boolean, folder: string, groupChats: string[], dmPhones: string[], useAdminPhones: boolean }), 'loadBalancing' (multi-channel round-robin — { enabled: boolean, strategy: string }), 'welcomeNewMembers' (fine-tune welcome behavior — { batchWindowSeconds: number, groupJids: string[] }). Additional custom keys are preserved as-is.

name.description: New display name for the bot

responsibilities.description: Array of responsibility descriptions defining what the bot handles

systemPrompt.description: New system prompt defining the bot's behavior and personality

welcomeMessage.description: Welcome message sent to new members joining groups the bot manages. Setting this field activates the batched welcome feature — new members are accumulated over a window (default 60s) and welcomed in a single message with @mentions. Set to null to disable.

whatsappChannelId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the WhatsApp channel to associate with the bot
